mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 2-quarter GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in industrial production over the same quarter signals restrictive monetary policy coinciding with supply-side stress, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls in the same quarter (t-test p > 0.05).
